values.en: $X\simeq_h Y$ denotes a type of witnesses, not a proposition. Its fields are $f,g$ and proofs of the two homotopy-existence statements; it does not choose homotopies. For example, $g\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$ means that $\mathrm{Homotopy}(g\circ f,\mathrm{id}_X)$ is nonempty. Here $\mathrm{id}_X$ is the continuous identity map, written with the existing identity notation. No basepoint or fixed subset is imposed. A homotopy inverse need not be a strict inverse: the composites are required only to be homotopic to the identities, not equal to them. Neither map is required to be bijective.
values.zh-CN: $X\simeq_h Y$ 表示见证类型，而非命题。其字段为 $f,g$ 及两条同伦存在命题的证明，并不选取具体同伦。例如 $g\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$ 表示 $\mathrm{Homotopy}(g\circ f,\mathrm{id}_X)$ 非空。这里 $\mathrm{id}_X$ 是连续恒等映射，沿用既有恒等记号；不要求基点或固定子集。 同伦逆不必是严格逆：两个复合仅要求与恒等映射同伦，不要求相等；两个映射也都不要求是双射。
